editorial.blurb: Mr Kimchi is a spacious, welcoming Korean AYCE BBQ spot where attentive servers guide you through an impressive spread of fresh, flavorful grilled meats and banchan.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (regulars praise Alec and Lou) for recommendations on the different pricing tiers and don't miss the ramen bar; they're great at refilling your grill and keeping meat portions coming.

topDishes.note: highly recommended banchan that pairs perfectly
